text:
Ellen M: Quick proposal 1: run a tight 6-week design partner sprint focused on canary + rollback guardrails. Target 6 partners but cap to 4 if SE capacity is low.
Devon S: +1. recruiting filter idea: infra/SRE contacts, >1k req/day, can share anonymized traces, ok with a 2-week canary route.
Ravi P: incentives: $2k credits + 2 SE hours. keep weekly asks light: one 5-min checklist + an automated eval run.
Ellen M: eval job example: `redwood eval run --suite dp-canary-smoke --out s3://dp-canary/{{partner}}/week{{n}}` -> emits p50,p95,cost/token, fallback-success.
Devon S: feedback flow: Google form -> ops-bot -> create GitHub issue with labels `dp/partner`, `area:serving`, `severity`. ops-bot?
ops-bot: will add the zap and a short issue template (ETA 72h).
Ravi P: success criteria proposal: 4/6 complete program, >=3 validated fallback flows, no P0 regressions, actionable Optimize suggestions for >=2 partners.
Ellen M: timeline: start recruiting next week, pilot in June. I'll draft outreach DM + onboarding doc and post to #product-dp-assets by EOD.
Devon S: I'll compile a shortlist of 8 possible partners and prioritize ops-minded ones.
Ellen M: awesome. next step: finalize checklist and canary policy example. keep it low-friction. :thumbsup:
